title: Transitive protobuf-dependent pins for TensorFlow test env go in the tensorflow models requirements block
answers: TensorFlow cross-version tests fail with protobuf gencode/runtime VersionError
google.rpc error_details_pb2 import fails in tensorflow test job
why is googleapis-common-protos pinned for tensorflow tests
tensorflow models test env protobuf version mismatch
body:
Symptom: The tensorflow cross-version test jobs (models 2.18.1 / 2.19.1) fail with "Detected incompatible Protobuf Gencode/Runtime versions when loading google/rpc/error_details.proto" after an upstream release.
Root cause: mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml:tensorflow.models.requirements (">= 0.0.0" selector) installs TensorFlow's protobuf<6 runtime, while a newer googleapis-common-protos regenerates gencode for protobuf 6.33, so `from google.rpc import error_details_pb2` (pulled in via pyspark.testing) fails the runtime check.
Fix pattern: Add a transitive package upper bound (here "googleapis-common-protos<1.75.1") to that requirements list, with a YAML comment naming the protobuf conflict. Do not change the TensorFlow maximum or protobuf pins for this.
Constraints: Scoped to the TF test environment only; nothing user-facing changes. 1.75.0 is the last release whose gencode loads on protobuf 5.x. Remove the pin once TensorFlow allows protobuf 6.33+ or googleapis-common-protos ships protobuf-5-compatible gencode.
applies: Test requirements under the tensorflow block of mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml when a transitive dependency breaks the protobuf runtime pin.
says: TensorFlow test jobs in our continuous integration pipeline are failing after an upstream release.
Continuous integration cross-version tests fail on protocol buffer compatibility checks.
Fix runtime version incompatibility errors in automated test runs for machine learning models.
Pin conflicting test dependencies so automated model validation builds pass again.
search: Transitive package upper bounds for TensorFlow test environments must be added directly to tensorflow.models.requirements in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml. This addresses cross-version test failures where googleapis-common-protos gencode for protobuf 6.33 conflicts with the protobuf<6 runtime required by TensorFlow. Pins such as googleapis-common-protos<1.75.1 require a YAML comment naming the conflict without modifying TensorFlow maximum or protobuf pins. The rule is scoped strictly to the test environment and should be removed once upstream compatibility is restored.
